title: Normalization and left refinement inputs for coefficient assembly
statement: Fix the finite-field datum D, prime l different from D.p, algebraic closure Omega, finite-type schemes X,Y and separated finite-type map f of the coefficient construction data. Given ring, rational and common-stage construction records R,F,M, CoefficientConstructionNormalization says ring left realizations commute with inherited shifts, the scalar shifts are independent of compactification, and rationalization q is literally identity on represented objects, and the closed-stage left functor sends each common-stage transition isomorphism (i ≤ j) to the conjugate of the rational scalar q between the common fields by the common-stage q maps (commonTransitionNatural). The closed category is the pair category, whose arrows between different finite stages are not images of one stage inclusion; this field pins the closed left functors on them. CoefficientLeftRefinements gives, for each proper refinement and every stage, only a shift-compatible isomorphism of left functors, normalized by the canonical proper/open word at ring stages, raw localization at rational stages, and conjugation by common-stage q at the closed stage. The right map used in the ring normalization predicate is the explicit adjunction conjugate, not an assumed right refinement.
